description: This file defines the OrderService interface in Java for handling order-related operations, including total calculations, order processing, invoice generation, and order retrieval in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: A Java interface defining services related to order management, including total calculation, order processing, invoice generation, and historical status tracking.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a status history record to an order.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total order amount based on OrderSummary, Customer, Store, and Language. (Note: 'calculate' is misspelled as 'caculate' in method names.)

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total for a ShoppingCart including customer and store information.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Generates a PDF or similar invoice stream for an order.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an Order object by its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders for a given store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Overloaded method; retrieves orders based on store and criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates an Order entity.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order with specified customer, items, summary, payment, and store information.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Overloaded method to process an order including transaction details.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks if an order has associated downloadable files.
